theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The user requested a 'beige/crema' background with 'negro/antracita' typography for a 'sobria, jurídico moderno alta gama' feel. This aligns with a light-mode Luxury archetype that relies on strong typography, ample negative space, and a crisp, authoritative tone without imagery.

typography.primary_font_usage: H1, H2, H3, large expressive numbers, quotes. Should use tracking-tight and leading-none for large sizes.
typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, UI elements, labels, buttons, form inputs. Should be highly legible and clean.
rules: Never center everything. Use left-aligned text to create a structured, editorial document feel.
Overlines or small labels MUST be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs to text-sm.
Use massive font scales for headers (text-5xl md:text-6xl+) to act as the primary visual element since there are no photos.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32. Use generous padding to create a sense of premium exclusivity and calm.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Use 1px solid borders (border-border) to expose the grid on value proposition sections and forms.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm. No bubbly or highly rounded corners. Keep it sharp and official.

hero.style: Massive typography. H1 spanning almost full width. High contrast. Left aligned. Purely typographic. No images.
hero.cta: Flat background (Anthracite), text (Cream). Hover state: slightly lighter background (#2C2C2C). No shadows.

value_proposition.style: CSS Grid (border-collapse). 4 distinct blocks. Use large, thin icons. Generous inner padding (p-8 or p-12). 1px borders dividing the blocks.

about.style: Typographic block. Consider a large serif drop-cap or oversized quotation style to introduce her.

process.style: Vertical or horizontal timeline. Use giant serif numerals (1, 2, 3) contrasting with sans-serif descriptions. Connected by a 1px anthracite line.

checklist.style: Clean list with custom check icons (lucide-react). High contrast text.

form.style: Shadcn-based but completely restyled. Use stark rectangles, 1px borders, Anthracite focus rings (focus:ring-[#1A1A1A]). Use Manrope for inputs.

footer.style: Inverted dark mode: Anthracite background (#1A1A1A) with Cream text (#FAF9F6). Massive typography for 'DRA. BRENDA M. RUBIO'. Include contact info.

floating_whatsapp.style: Fixed bottom right. Anthracite or standard WhatsApp Green background, white icon. Minimalist shadow.

icons.style: Stroke width 1 to 1.5. Large sizes for visual impact. Color: Anthracite (#1A1A1A).

images.description: Minimalist architecture. To be used ONLY as a very low-opacity texture or in an editorial half-column if a visual break is absolutely necessary. Otherwise, stick to pure typography.

testing.rules: All interactive elements, buttons, form fields, and main sections MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta"`, `data-testid="contact-form"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure `Cormorant Garamond` (font-serif) and `Manrope` (font-sans) in Tailwind.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for main layouts to maintain the asymmetrical, editorial design. Do not use generic card components.
For the form, use Shadcn UI (Input, Textarea, Button) but override the default styles to be flat, zero-radius, and match the Beige/Anthracite palette.
Implement the WhatsApp floating button with `data-testid='whatsapp-float'`.
DO NOT add any photos of a person. The design must remain strictly typographic and iconographic as requested by the user.
Implement the backend for the form (MongoDB + Resend) as specified by the user's stack.
Ensure high contrast and accessibility. The aesthetic is 'sobria, jurídico moderno alta gama'.
